scene: The friendly weaver offers you a spool of glowing, silver thread.
picture: Along a straight stone arcade floor, a closed wooden trapdoor sits on the left. The woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands at center, facing right. The cheerful old weaver stands on the right, offering a gleaming spool of silver thread. A spiral iron staircase climbs upwards at the far right.
shown: the bright silver thread spool held in the smiling weaver's outstretched hand on the right
a small wooden trapdoor set flat into the stone floor on the left
a winding iron staircase ascending toward a leafy balcony at the far right
